summary: FERC grants the abeyance motions of PJM, the Indicated PJM Transmission Owners and Silver Run, holding the E-7 show cause proceeding for 90 days. Responses move to November 16, 2026 and answers to December 16, 2026.

points.point: FERC holds the whole EL26-67 proceeding in abeyance for 90 days, moving show cause responses to November 16 and answers to December 16, 2026.
points.quote: responses to the Show Cause Order will be due on November 16, 2026, and answers to responses will be due on December 16, 2026.

points.point: A section 205 filing by November 16 suspends the filer's obligation to respond to the show cause order.
points.quote: then the obligation of the respondent(s) who have made such an FPA section 205 filing to file a response to the Show Cause Order will be suspended

points.point: PJM says its planned filing will cover study processes, cost shifting, services for flexible large loads, and generation serving proximate large loads.
points.quote: (1) achieve efficient transmission service application and study processes, including through the consideration of alternative transmission technologies; (2) prevent cost shifting and enhance transparency into transmission costs

points.point: PJM plans an advisory stakeholder vote at the Members Committee on October 28, 2026.
points.quote: with the goal of taking an advisory stakeholder vote on the proposal at the Members Committee meeting on October 28, 2026.

points.point: The Indicated Transmission Owners expect to file pro forma cost recovery agreements and penalties for exceeding contractual service limits.
points.quote: pro forma cost recovery agreements and rates for new transmission services for flexible large loads and electrically proximate large loads or co-located loads

points.point: FERC encourages filers to explain which proposed revisions resolve the show cause findings and to set effective dates that respect existing commercial arrangements.
points.quote: we encourage PJM and/or Transmission Owners to explain, with specificity, which of their proposed Tariff revisions they believe resolve all or some of the Commission’s preliminary findings

throughLine.text: Postpones the E-7 60-day show cause deadline for PJM and its Transmission Owners to November 16, 2026, in exchange for section 205 filings on study, cost and flexible service topics.
